messages:
anya: Short sync  need thumbs on GA defaults for reserved-pool burst (defaults, rollovers, ops controls).
raj: Proposal: default max_burst_per_tenant=120 (2x typical baseline), monthly_rollover=true up to 100% cap, credit_expiry_cycles=1.
lina: SRE: hard-guard at 3x absolute max; recommend progressive prewarm ramp over 30s to avoid 95p spikes.
nick: Engineering: implement contracted-burst-window as enterprise opt-in; ledger will track credits, eventual consistency ~30s. Add admin endpoints to adjust credits and to force-shed.
anya: Rollout: dark-launch behind flag, opt-in canary (3 tenants). Gates: 95p latency <300ms, error_rate <0.5%, billing_reconcile_diff_ratio <0.002 over 24h. If gate fails -> auto-fallback to soft-throttle.
raj: I'll add metrics and Prom gate rules to per-route dashboard (ETA Thu).
lina: Ops needs APIs: POST /admin/tenants/{id}/shed?mode=throttle and /admin/tenants/{id}/drain. Must emit audit tag ops_action and caller_id. Also add telemetry labels burst_source and spill_cause.
nick: Will add RFC for ledger + admin endpoints. Expect ~1.5 sprint work.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: feature-flag reserve-burst-ga created (off).
anya: Next steps: (1) Raj - metrics + gate (Thu), (2) Nick - RFC & admin endpoints (Fri), (3) Lina - runbook + alerts (Fri), (4) Anya - comms + SLA appendix draft (Fri). Review Mon 10am.
andy: (typo) andy: pinging legal for expiry wording.
anya: Thanks team. Keep any edge cases (cross-region spills, multi-tenant flaps) in this thread.
